statement: In the setting of this section, for every y ∈ M◦ the map Ky(f) = EA(y∗ fy), f ∈ A, has a positive kernel whose mass is at most ∥y∥2 and which is atomless for almost every output point v ∈ X. For k ≥ 1 and y1, . . . , yk ∈ M◦, the composition Ky1 ◦ · · · ◦ Kyk has a positive kernel whose 11 mass is at most Qk j=1 ∥yj∥2 and which is atomless almost everywhere. If pat ∈ A is the projection of the atomic part of A, then paty = ypat = 0 (y ∈ M◦ ).
